title: Jim Semivan of the CIA briefed that psi and mind-matter connection are real

tellings.quote: tangentially related to UFOs. And they say that the size stuff, the parasychology, the idea that mind and matter are not, you know, partitioned, they're connected, is the kind of real core truth. All of that is real.

plain: Michels says that people like Jim Semivan, a former officer of the CIA, the US spy agency, have said that psychic powers and the idea that mind and matter are connected, not separate, are "the kind of real core truth. All of that is real." Michels repeats this himself, without naming where it was said, and calls it only tangentially related to UFOs. If true, it would mean insiders believe the mind can act on the physical world.
